name: Fever Event Discovery
description: Discover and explore live entertainment experiences worldwide through Fever. Search events by city, date, location, or keyword across concerts, shows, festivals, immersive experiences, and more. Filter by popularity, price, rating, or proximity. Get event details including schedules, venues, ratings, and pricing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fever Event Discovery to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fever Event Discovery to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data-search.apigw.feverup.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fever Event Discovery MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fever Event Discovery provides these MCP tools: search_cities and search_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fever Event Discovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fever Event Discovery in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Fever Event Discovery MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fever Event Discovery requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fever Event Discovery is developed by Fever. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
